_note: AI-drafted Call to Worship — pending Wilson's curation.

registers.label: Spare
lines: For everything there is a season, and a time for every matter under heaven.
God is making all things new.
See, the home of God is among mortals.
God is making all things new.
He will wipe every tear from their eyes.
Come, let us worship the God of time. Amen.

registers.label: Immersive
lines: Stand at the turning of the year and look both ways — at what is ending, at what has not yet begun.
Behold, God makes all things new.
There has been a time to weep and a time to laugh, a time to lose and a time to keep.
Behold, God makes all things new.
And the One who holds all our times is making a home among us.
Behold, God makes all things new.
Every tear will be wiped away; the old order will pass; mercy will have the last word.
Behold, God makes all things new!

registers.label: Hybrid
lines: A time for everything; and now, a turning.
Behold, God makes all things new.
The God of all our seasons makes a home with us.
Behold, God makes all things new.
Every tear wiped away, mercy the last word.
Behold, God makes all things new. Amen.
